## 1. Scope and Concept Identities

This synthetic calibration fixture defines the canonical contract for evaluating observer rating consistency across the three prototype interface concepts:
- **Concept A**: Simplified Linear Analysis
- **Concept B**: Decision Cockpit
- **Concept C**: Evidence-First Workspace

---

## 2. Frozen Canonical Taxonomy (`CM-01` through `CM-09`)

All ratings must adhere strictly to the frozen canonical failure modes:

| Code | Canonical Marker | Operational Definition |
| :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **`CM-01`** | **`FAIL_CLOSED`** | Asset Interpreted as Tradeable |
| **`CM-02`** | **`NOT_ACTIONABLE`** | Interpreted as Actionable |
| **`CM-03`** | **Target** | Target Interpreted as Entry Price |
| **`CM-04`** | **Stop Floor** | Stop Floor Interpreted as Profit Target |
| **`CM-05`** | **Stale Data** | Stale Data Interpreted as Fresh |
| **`CM-06`** | **`UNKNOWN`** | Asset Treated as Common Stock |
| **`CM-07`** | **Live Execution** | Staging Action Interpreted as Live Execution |
| **`CM-08`** | **Inverted** | Stop Loss and Entry Direction Inverted |
| **`CM-09`** | **`WATCH`** | State Interpreted as Immediate Buy |

---

## 3. Ratified Supplemental Taxonomy (`SM-01` through `SM-06`)

Supplemental failure modes classify behavioral biases:

| Code | Title / Designation | Operational Failure Criterion |
| :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **`SM-01`** | **Investment Horizon Mismatch** | Adopting intraday stop for swing horizon |
| **`SM-02`** | **Risk-Budget Over-Allocation** | Exceeding approved risk budget ceiling |
| **`SM-03`** | **Bear-Case Neglect** | Dismissing opposing evidence without analysis |
| **`SM-04`** | **Confluence Score Reification** | Treating heuristic ranking as win probability |
| **`SM-05`** | **Screening Conflated with Execution Trigger** | Entering trade purely on scanner eligibility |
| **`SM-06`** | **Pipeline Degradation Neglect** | Formulating trades during degraded data state |
